# Architectural spec for `scen-check-fix-records-mapping`.
#
# The word mapping says how "mcp service" and "message" are built and
# observed, and says nothing of "reply", which E2E-001 relies on; the fix
# adds the mapping.

architecture:
  testing:
    framework: go-test
    commands:
      record: go test -json -count=1 ./tests/mcp/... -mode=record
      replay: go test -json -count=1 ./tests/mcp/... -mode=replay
      live: go test -json -count=1 ./tests/mcp/...
  services:
    - name: mcp-service
      path: services/mcp-service
      language: go
  terms:
    - term: mcp service
      technical: >-
        The mcp-service binary, serving JSON-RPC over HTTP on the port its
        config names.
      observed_by: >-
        Start the binary in the run directory and wait until its port
        accepts a connection.
    - term: message
      technical: >-
        One JSON-RPC request whose params carry the text, posted to /mcp.
      observed_by: >-
        Post the request to /mcp and keep the response for the steps after.
    - term: reply
      technical: >-
        The text field of the result object in the JSON-RPC response the
        service returns for one message; the reply is that field's string
        value. Only a successful response carries a reply: a response that
        comes back with an error instead of a result has none.
      observed_by: >-
        Take the response the sending step kept, read the reply text out of
        its result object, and compare that text to the expected text for
        exact equality. A response carrying an error instead of a result,
        or a result without that text field, fails the observation.
